items.stem: What is the purpose of three-way matching in accounts payable?

options.text: To confirm the invoice agrees with the purchase order and the goods receipt before payment
options.rationale: Correct: three-way matching checks invoice against PO and receipt to prevent paying for goods not ordered or received.

options.text: To split one invoice across three cost centres automatically
options.rationale: Three-way matching compares three documents; it does not split costs.

options.text: To pay the vendor three times for redundancy
options.rationale: It prevents overpayment, not triplicate payment.

options.text: To convert the invoice into three separate approvals
options.rationale: It refers to three documents, not three approvers.

items.explanation: Correct: three-way matching checks invoice against PO and receipt to prevent paying for goods not ordered or received.

items.stem: Which practices strengthen controls against accounts payable fraud? (Select TWO)

options.text: Verifying vendor bank-detail changes through an independent channel
options.rationale: Correct: independently confirming bank changes defeats a common invoice-redirection scheme.

options.text: Separating vendor setup from invoice approval and payment
options.rationale: Correct: segregation of duties stops one person from both creating a vendor and paying it.

options.text: Letting the person who approves invoices also create new vendors
options.rationale: Combining these duties removes a key control.

options.text: Removing the audit trail to speed up processing
options.rationale: An audit trail is a core control, not an obstacle to remove.

items.explanation: Correct: independently confirming bank changes defeats a common invoice-redirection scheme.; Correct: segregation of duties stops one person from both creating a vendor and paying it.

items.stem: A supplier offers 2/10 net 30. Taking the discount means:

options.text: Paying within 10 days to take a 2 percent discount instead of paying the full amount at 30 days
options.rationale: Correct: 2/10 net 30 gives a 2 percent discount for payment within 10 days, otherwise full amount by day 30.

options.text: Paying 2 percent extra if you wait the full 30 days
options.rationale: It is a discount for early payment, not a surcharge.

options.text: Paying in 2 days or forfeiting the order
options.rationale: The early-payment window is 10 days, not 2.

options.text: Receiving 30 percent off for paying in 2 days
options.rationale: The figures are a 2 percent discount within 10 days.

items.explanation: Correct: 2/10 net 30 gives a 2 percent discount for payment within 10 days, otherwise full amount by day 30.
